title: hm2b.projection-options/v1
description: Resolved projection options, echoed into a projection result. Documentation only: projection/options.js is authoritative (normalizeOptions / validateOptions). Raw input may omit fields or pass null for stageOrder, skills and targets; the resolved echo always carries concrete arrays.
$comment: Rules the caller enforces and this document does not express: options.compiledWorkflow.digest/id/version must equal the input compiled workflow and its digest; stageOrder is a permutation of the compiled workflow stage ids; skills is a unique subset of the compiled workflow skill ids, sorted by code point; targets is a non-empty unique subset of the manifest targets in manifest order; extra keys are sorted recursively and validated against the manifest optionsSchema (empty extra when none is declared); options bind the compiled workflow and are never written back to the bundle or compiled workflow.

projection.description: Must equal the projection being called.

stageOrder.description: Applied stage order; the resolved echo never uses null.

skills.description: Installed/registered skill ids; the empty array is legal.

targets.description: Selected manifest target ids in manifest order.

extra.description: Projection-defined options, validated against the manifest optionsSchema; {} when none is declared.
